frontmatter.name: prd-sync
frontmatter.description: Brings the PRDs in the sibling repo prd-molcadx up to date with spec changes in docs-molcadx (AGENTS.md §5 rule 1b). Works from the git diff of DOMAINS/<DOMAIN>/DOCS-EN, UX and FLOW since each PRD's recorded sync point — not from the changelog and not by reading every document. Maps each changed spec section to the PRD stories that link to it or name its fields, reads only those in full, edits them, moves the sync point, and opens a PR. Use when the PO asks to sync / update a PRD after spec chang

nodes.label: Work Unit Flow working draft
nodes.rationale: Neither ISO 22400 nor ISA-95 defines which physical machine feeds which other machine on a specific factory floor — this is plant-specific layout data FOUNDATION currently has no entity for.

nodes.label: At-least-once + idempotency delivery guarantee
nodes.rationale: Exactly-once is expensive and often an illusion in distributed systems, so the '0 data loss' KR target in practice means at-least-once plus idempotency on the receiving end.

nodes.label: Starvation rule (all predecessors down)
nodes.rationale: A work unit is starved only when every declared predecessor is down — covers series and parallel/merge topology without a separate series-vs-parallel flag.

nodes.label: Workflow definition vs instance
nodes.rationale: A running instance locks the version of its definition so a mid-flight approval can't jump to a different person when the definition is reconfigured.

nodes.label: Metric anatomy (7-part definition)
nodes.rationale: Requires name, definition, formula, data source, population, baseline, target+date on every metric so PRD metrics can be queried, not debated.
